title: meter.sample, v1
description: One MeterValue element of a MeterValues request, with units normalised to Wh, W, A and percent. timestamp is the element's timestamp. README.md rules M1-M7 say which sampled values are used; conformance.json pins them.

energy_wh.description: Energy.Active.Import.Register, in Wh, or null. Phases are summed (rule M4).

power_w.description: Power.Active.Import, in W, or null. Phases are summed (rule M4).

current_a.description: Current.Import, in A, or null. The maximum over phases (rule M4).

soc_percent.description: SoC, in percent, or null. The first SoC value, any location (rules M3, M5).

context.description: OCPP 1.6 ReadingContext of the values used, or null when the first used value has none or an unknown one (rule M6; OCPP's default is Sample.Periodic).
